OF FEBRUARY 2, 1914, PROVIDING CONDITIONS OF
EMPLOYMENT FOR THE PERMANENT FORCE FOR
THE PANAMA CANAL.
By virtue of the authority vested in me by law, Section 3 of an [Executive
Order providing conditions of employment for the permanent force of the
Panania Canal, issued February 2, 1914, is hereby amended. so as to read as
follows: | Gav} beyae? hor BES

’ day exclusive of Sundays, [acept in case of discharge or other separation
